remarks: INVESTORS, FIRST-TIME BUYERS & SHORT-TERM RENTAL ENTREPRENEURS! Welcome to Unit 1002 at Cambridge Lofts, a warm and inviting north-facing loft in the heart of downtown Edmonton. Enjoy unbeatable convenience with Central LRT access connected directly to the building, making commuting effortless year-round. Steps from Rice Howard Way, Rogers Place, Churchill Square, City Centre Mall, restaurants, cafés, pubs, theatres, the public library, museums, the funicular, and the River Valley, this location offers the best of doorstep.
